name: Jira
desc: Issues, changelog, story points, versions and links. The backbone of both evidence and flow.
fields: Cloud site or Data Center base URL.
Used when a query runs on a schedule rather than on a user's behalf.
Stored in the vault, rotated every 90 days.
Restricts every query this instance can run.
Risk tier → customfield_10412, Detection stage → customfield_10488
Maps Backbase fields to the canonical model.
rate: Cloud rate limits apply; sync backs off automatically.

name: Confluence
desc: Requirements, test plans, HLD/LLD, threat models and NFR sign-off pages, discovered by label.
fields: Same Atlassian site as Jira in most setups.
CQL is restricted to these spaces.
sl-requirements, sl-testplan, sl-hld, sl-lld, sl-threatmodel, sl-performance, sl-accessibility
Which page label satisfies which checklist artifact.

name: Xray
desc: Test sets, executions, traceability to requirements, and automated results imported from CI.
auth: API key — client ID + client secret (Cloud)
fields: Cloud uses an API key pair; Server/DC uses a Jira PAT instead.
From Xray Global Settings → API Keys.
Exchanged for a bearer token that expires after 24h; refreshed automatically.
scopes: Inherits the API key user's Jira permissions.
rate: 300 requests / 5 min on Standard, 1000 on Enterprise.

name: GitHub
desc: Pull requests, reviews, changed files, Actions runs, check results and deployments.
fields: Installation is scoped to this org.
Created once by a platform admin.
Signs the app JWT; stored in the vault.
Enables near-real-time PR and run updates instead of polling.

name: Bitbucket
desc: Alternative source for pull requests and pipelines where a team has not migrated to GitHub.
fields: Explicit list; wildcards are not accepted.

name: SonarQube
desc: Coverage on changed files, new violations and quality-gate status per branch.
fields: Generated for a read-only service user.
Determines which analysis the widgets read.
scopes: Browse permission on the listed projects.
rate: No published limit; polled every 30 min.

name: CI (GitHub Actions)
desc: Workflow runs, durations, first-attempt pass rate, and the artifacts that carry NFR evidence.
fields: Artifact names the connector looks for on each run.
How far back runs are ingested.
rate: Shared with the GitHub installation budget.

name: Jenkins
desc: For teams still on Jenkins pipelines rather than Actions.
fields: Required when CSRF protection is on.

name: LinearB
desc: PR cycle time, size distribution and review latency, already normalised per team.
fields: Maps a LinearB team to a project here.
Mirror the scope in both tools or PRs count against the wrong team.

name: Jira Service Management
desc: Incidents, escaped defects and the alert destination for release-blocking findings.
fields: Used to attribute change failures to a deployment.
Where high-severity findings are raised as tickets.

name: Slack
desc: Delivery channel for unacknowledged high-severity findings, so they don't wait to be noticed.
fields: xoxb- token from the installed app.
Per-project overrides live in Alert routes.
Anything lower stays on the dashboard only.

name: Sentry
desc: Release regressions and crash-rate signals feeding the post-deploy detection metric.
fields: Internal integration token, read scopes only.
Lets a regression be attributed to a release.

name: PagerDuty
desc: Optional paging target for release-blocking findings. Deferred in v1 — Slack and JSM cover the launch case.
fields: Read-only REST key for service lookup.
Events API v2 key for the target service.
Which services may be paged from here.
rate: Event API is rate limited per routing key.

name: Figma
desc: Presence of visual design for a feature — file and frame existence only, never file content.
fields: Read-only token for a service account.
frame name contains the Jira key
How a design is matched to a feature.
rate: Polled hourly; design changes rarely need faster.

name: Datadog
desc: Optional. Post-deploy service health for the Maintain loop and executive MTTR.
fields: Region matters — EU and US are separate endpoints.
Which objects contribute to the widgets.

name: Security scanners
desc: SAST and dependency findings. Presence and status only — finding content stays in the source tool.
fields: Each scanner is a separate instance.
Findings below this are not surfaced here.
Titles and payloads are never stored by the platform.
